attrs.text: I've never seen you around here.~Are you new? The Oracle gets many visitors from afar.~...Sometimes, he even creates life.
The Goreback, first deceased of the Creatures of the Relic.

Hello, young soul.~I am the Oracle.~I see you have begun a life of your own.~That sword you hold, it has great power.~It will help you on your journey.~For I did not create you from the wind on a whim.~It is the Tree, you see.~The Tree will begin its death cycle soon...~And I need a seed to replace my beloved.~For that, I created you.~I care not how you go about this--whatever good or evil you might do...~It matters not to me.  Just bring me a seed.
attrs.text1: I am waiting, my child.~As you linger, my beloved Tree dies.

attrs.text: Hehehe~Double, double, toil and trouble...~*Sigh* what a poor witch I am, with no wand.~I have sought the wand for some time...~...sadly, it is stuck up in blue-stoned Lacste, guarded by the Totem.

Watch out for that hole!~It's the home of the Times, Creatures of the Relic.~It's told that there are three, each of a different age.~Get too close to that hole, and you might get sucked in and meet them!
Wait for your opening against the Shieldspire.

...Zzzzz...~Hurm?~Oh, I must've fallen asleep.~I had the craziest nightmare.~There was a horrible, inky blackness crawling over our land...~...and I watched as the owner's of our land's realms were killed by it!~Glad I woke up! I always loved playing with Relic toys when I was young.~Having huge fights between the Shieldspire and Tentacled Beast...~Ah, those were the days!

A huge rock fell from the sky just across the way.~Do you know anything about it?~I heard it fell over the "Nest of the Owl."~It's basically just a hole in the ground, but it is~supposedly the home of a Creature of the Relic.~The Owl is fabled to be a small, innocuous creature.~He will cause small tremors when threatened, and hops around.~It is told that, long ago, a horrible beast came,~and he was sealed in front of the Nest with a warning.~Anyways, this is all just storytelling. Have a drink!
I run this bar myself.~It's a small place, but I wish I had more business.~People told me the woods wouldn't be great for a bar...~...they were right.

Ever heard of the "Creatures of the Relic"?~A fascinating tale, really.~The myth centers around eight magical Relic Creatures.~They are the Shieldspire, the Times, the Totem of Lacste,~the Tentacled Beast, the Lights, the King of Fire, the Owl, and the Watcher.~Each of the first seven has their own powers and domain.~But the Watcher...~He can go anywhere he likes, and he watches all.~The Watcher is seen most often around injustice in the world, but the other~seven remain in their place, safely out of our hair!
I AM ADNAN.~DESTROYER OF WORLDS.
Welcome to Lacste, the last of the Great Structures.
Herm's mah name.~I seen you runnin' around here.~Shieldspire and the Times 'ave taken a fall.~Ain't sayin' I'm 'appy about whatcha doin'.~Whateva yo' reasons, they betta' be good.

You must think you're clever.~Coming so quickly to the north. But you are unprepared, fool.~I am Sardol.~For me, you will find and destroy all of the Creatures.~None will escape. Turn and come back in due time.

How did you--oh no.~Did you kill the Tentacled Beast?~This is my home! You've ruined it!~But how strong you must be to have killed the Tentacled Beast...~Please, get out! Don't kill me! Woe is me, my friend is dead...

Hello, stranger.~It is rare that I get visitors--my home is far from hospitable for most.~Even, at points, for me.~My spear has helped me through it all, though.~It is an enchanted weapon, capable of more than just inflicting pain.~I have decided to leave this place, but...~...I feel that taking this spear would not be right.~Its home is in the hands of a warrior.~Please, take it for me.
Sardol slays the Goreback's guardian.

There is an interesting story behind the man in this statue.~The eight Creatures of the Relic are legendary beasts with mystical powers.~There once existed nine, but the terrible knight Sardol sought to kill them.~He attacked and killed the Goreback and is now hated throughout history for it.~These statues serve as monuments to his cruelty.
Sometimes, if you lie on the ground...~...You can hear the sounds of the King of Fire deep beneath us...
Hm, looks like there's something up that waterfall over there.
This here is the Oracle's tree.~He loves it a lot.~People used to think it had mystical powers, but it doesn't.~It's just very large!
Yo, I hear music everywhere...~Press <W> to hear what I hear!
This creature stands as a testament to the punishment~that reckless evil is dealt in these lands.~-The Watcher

You...~You're the reason for all of this.~I see all, and I've seen you with your... weapons.~I watched you kill the Shieldspire, the Times...~...the Totem of Lacste, the Tentacled Beast, the Lights, the King of Fire...~...even burning the Owl to death in his own nest.~While you mauled your victims...~Did you ever once think?~How you kill everything, everything in your path.~All for this?~This little seed, a seed that will serve to please a master you've only but met?~I saw you, and I tried to stop you.~It was I that dropped the Sky Rock when you killed the Shieldspire.~Little did I know that it would only cause you to destroy more.~It pushed you to do more than I could have imagined.~This is why I must stop you.~If you want this seed, you will have to kill me.~Here, before you. In cold blood.~If you turn back to find a bloodless seed, only then will you be redeemed.~Now, kill me or find another way.
attrs.text1: Kill me or seek redemption with a bloodless seed.~The choice lies with you.

attrs.text: You have taken a step towards morality.~The Watcher would be pleased...~...As will your conscience.
